verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers connecting Ollama to external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex), REST/Python/JS APIs, and OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility, but nothing describes creating a customized assistant (e.g., a Modelfile-style system prompt/parameter configuration) tailored to a specific persona or task. Missing for 10: any mention of Modelfile creation, custom system prompts, or persona/parameter configuration for specialized assistants.
